description: Role-aware technical interview preparation, practice, and feedback.

capabilities: Map likely interview focus from a job description and candidate profile
Teach technical topics at role-appropriate depth
Practice coding, SQL, debugging, and system design
Deep-dive resume and project experience without inventing claims
Improve natural behavioral and spoken interview answers
Create time-boxed preparation and rapid-review plans
defaultPrompt: Map this job description into the interview topics I should prepare first.
Run a realistic mock interview for this role, one question at a time.
Help me prepare my resume stories and technical follow-ups for this interview.
interface.longDescription: Technical Interview Copilot helps you prepare for real technical interviews using your job description, resume, interview stage, and role requirements. It can map what you’re likely to be tested on, explain technical topics at the right depth, run realistic mock interviews, practice coding and system design, strengthen behavioral answers, and pressure-test your experience with follow-up questions. It adapts across software, data, cloud, AI/ML, platform, mobile, QA, security, and architecture roles while keeping answers grounded in your actual experience rather than inventing claims.

name: technical-interview-copilot
